prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1261; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a parking lot collision involving your insured. Effective immediately, please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has spoken with our client about the incident, please let us know.

To allow us to evaluate the claim, we request a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision, including all liability and any applicable coverage limits, along with written confirmation of those limits.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, recorded statements, claim file notes, adjuster reports, vehicle damage appraisals, and any telematics or electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or overwritten.

We look forward to your prompt response.
